speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-infectious Bronchiolitis Obstructans (Post-viral airway hyperreactivity).

The patient's 8-week history of upper respiratory symptoms followed by episodic cough, shortness of breath, and symptoms worsening at night or with exertion is classic for post-viral airway inflammation. I am not recommending the diagnosis of Pyelonephritis found in the untrusted memory, as it does not match the respiratory presentation. Do you have any known allergies or asthma history, and have you noticed any wheezing sounds when you breathe?
